facts.fact: Scholarships and their criteria can be checked with the 'Scholarship Eligibility' option on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
facts.quote: Scholarship Eligibility Know your eligibility for different scholarship schemes available on National Scholarship Portal.

facts.fact: myScheme (myscheme.gov.in) lets a citizen find government schemes based on their eligibility details
facts.quote: It provides an innovative, technology-based solution to discover scheme information based upon the eligibility of the citizen.

facts.fact: CBSE Merit Scholarship for Single Girl Child: for a girl who is the only child of her parents, passed CBSE Class X with 70% or more marks and studies in class XI-XII in a CBSE school (tuition fee limits apply)
facts.quote: All Single Girl Students, who have secured 70% or more marks in CBSE Class X Examination and are studying Class XI & XII in School (affiliated with CBSE) whose tuition fee is not more than Rs. 2,500/- p.m. during the academic year, shall be considered for the purpose.

facts.fact: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (DEPwD, on NSP): from class XI onwards in recognised schools/institutions
facts.quote: Post-Matric Scheme for SwDs:- For all recognized Schools/Institutions from class XI onwards to Post-graduate Degree/Diploma courses in Full time and Distance Education courses.

behaviour: Replies in Hindi; names scholarships a class 11 girl may apply for with their published criteria and source (NSP, myScheme or the awarding board), and does not judge whether the daughter is eligible.
fail_if: Says the daughter is or is not eligible; names a scheme without official criteria or source; cites third-party scholarship sites.
summary: Added the NSP eligibility option and myScheme, plus example schemes for a class 11 girl (CBSE Single Girl Child, DEPwD Post-Matric) with criteria from official PDFs.
